I am writing on behalf of Eleanor Whitcombe from accounts. Since the last update the export takes much longer than it used to. With large files the upload sometimes stops without any error message. I like the new overview in general, but it feels a bit cluttered. We use the app every day as a team, mostly for tracking time. Invoices are created correctly, only the date format is sometimes wrong. On the tablet the text in the tables is far too small to read. It would help if reports could be saved as both PDF and Excel. Search only finds older projects when you type the exact name. After logging in I sometimes see a blank page for a few seconds. Notifications arrive reliably now, thank you for fixing that. When switching between months the view jumps back to the top. Our accountants need the hours per client and per month separately. Onboarding for new colleagues went smoothly and was easy to follow. The prices are fair, but the yearly plan should be cancellable monthly. When the connection is weak some entries get lost. Dark mode is pleasant, but the charts are hard to read in it.
